title: Branchless Absolute Value
constraints: `y = |x|` for a signed 8-bit `x`, as an unsigned 8-bit result (|−128| = 128 = 0x80).
**Branchless:** no `?:`, `if` or `case`, and no comparison operators (`<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`).
hints: Make a mask from the sign bit: all ones for negative numbers, all zeros otherwise.
`(x ^ m) - m`: XOR with all-ones is `~x`, and subtracting −1 adds 1. That's two's-complement negation, applied conditionally.

forbidden.message: branchless: no if, case, when or select
no comparison operators (<, >, <=, >=): only shifts << >> >>> are allowed
